notes.title: Don't Get Fooled - The Deceiver Joins DEMONS!
notes.content:
[h1]A New Foe Awaits...[/h1]

Every new adversary that joins [b]DEMONS[/b] presents a fresh challenge and the Deceiver is no exception. You'll want to keep your flashlights handy when confronting this masked master of mayhem! Read on to find out why...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/3de72a528f862b7908798476fc0d5a810917e557.png[/img]

When you encounter the Deceiver during an investigation not only will you be knocked down, but you'll also see a [i]Terrifying Illusion[/i] card placed at a random location that does not already have one. Once all 5 locations are occupied by [i]Terrifying Illusion[/i] cards your team will lose the game. They'll start to cause you problems even before that though.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/6a1332c62f67246e10c71220129778243a19a799.png[/img]

Any location with a [i]Terrifying Illusion[/i] card will be blocked from investigation, making your quest to find the 10 [i]Altar[/i] cards you need to win the game much harder. However, you can use a [i]Flashlight[/i] card to send Terrifying Illusions to the discard pile - clearing the way for you to continue your searches.

As always with our demons, any encounter with the Deceiver will trigger an attack with a unique animation. We think you'll agree that this one is particularly disturbing...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/549d706030fd1371f53f134a9f763398aff77dc2.gif[/img]

[h2]The Future of DEMONS[/h2]

With the addition of the Deceiver to the game we've fulfilled our initial vision for [b]DEMONS[/b]. The ten demons that you can now challenge were the ones we originally crafted for the game. Further development for the game would require substantial investment that can't be supported by current sales - consequently we're taking the difficult decision to end active development on [b]DEMONS[/b]. 

[u]The game will still remain fully active, with multiplayer server support in place.[/u]

We're very proud that [b]DEMONS[/b] offers a multiplayer digital card game experience that is truly unique and hope that all of you will continue to enjoy sending the demons back to the void with your friends. We also welcome anyone joining us for the first time - click the banner below to join our Discord and find people to play the game with in our friendly community!
 
[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Happy Demon Hunting Friends![/h3]

Thanks for playing - we appreciate all of you!

notes.title: New Demon 'Mirrorgeist' Available To Challenge NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Prepare For A Fresh Challenge![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/79dc932559827a0db2d70c52a6604d95afca8147.png[/img]

Every foe presents their own challenge in [b]DEMONS[/b] and [i]Mirrorgeist[/i] brings a twist to gameplay that's unlike anything you've seen before. Each encounter with this ghostly adversary fills the deck with more and more [i]Horrifying Reflection[/i] cards. Reveal too many of them and you'll lose the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/e23d8f53cb8a8d9e88779b5c618114734175acee.png[/img]

[h2]New Perk Alert![/h2]

At DEMONS we love 80s horror films and few weapons bring that era of cinema to mind as clearly as the chainsaw! Our new perk gives you the chance to become a [i]Chainsaw Hero[/i] and dispatch cultists to the discard pile in the most brutal manner yet... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/2228b7a83c4eca9f6aa90833d0b65f7fd3d2279f.png[/img]

We've recreated the action packed feeling of those old chainsaw horror flicks in this perk by granting you an extra investigation when you kill a cultist using it. Make the most of it though, as once you've used it your chainsaw it will be sent to the discard pile!

[h2]Time Your Turn In Style[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/ffd08842fb4219ae8c0b2ed21e3036fc88015a7f.jpg[/img]

In addition to the new demon and perk, this update sees a new model and set of skins for the watch that serves as your turn timer in the game. You can visit the Fate Store in game and use tokens earned through play to unlock them immediately. 

Stressing about your time running out has never been so easy on the eyes! 

[h3]Until Next Time...[/h3]

Stay scary, [b]DEMONS[/b] fans! Don't forget that you can find friends to play the game with, as well as discuss strategy and much more over in our Discord community. Join us by clicking the banner below!

[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Terror That Leapt From The Mirror!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome back DEMONS fans![/h1]

Firstly, a huge thank you for your continuing support for the game. 

We've seen lots of you having fun banishing demons since we launched to Early Access and we appreciate every single one of you who has played. 

If you're enjoying the game but haven't connected with our community yet, you might want to consider joining us on Discord by clicking the banner below. We have a super friendly group of players there who are always looking for people to play with, sharing strategies and more...

[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

We're already looking ahead from release and we have some news about our first big update, which you can expect to drop roughly a month from now.

[h2]A Ghostly Apparition Emerges From The Glass...[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/6caa37b9ce8076df48d62352239f6eac7d2e81a9.png[/img]

The Mirrorgeist appears from the mists as the first new demon to join the game following our launch to early access. Her rules text remains a mystery for now, but we'd love to hear your guesses in the comments! Here's a clue to help you figure out some of what she's about...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/7310b9c47931e9c455d2510b77fdc9cb7de12c2a.png[/img]

It's exact function might be a mystery, but it's safe to say that you'll be wanting to avoid running into a Horrifying Reflection when you play against Mirrorgeist! 

[h2]The Fate Store Gets A Timely New Inclusion[/h2]

A new demon isn't the only thing you can expect to see with this update. The Fate Store gets a fresh addition too, in the form of an alternative design for your in-game watch - complete with a whole new set of skins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/ffd08842fb4219ae8c0b2ed21e3036fc88015a7f.jpg[/img]

The digital watch that serves as your standard turn timer is certainly stylish, but if you play a lot of DEMONS then you'll spend a lot of time looking at it and we wanted to offer you a totally different visual option for when you feel like changing things up. Now you can panic as time runs out on your turn with some real retro flair!

[h2]A New Perk[/h2]

We know you all love a good perk and this update will see a new one enter the game. We're keeping it a closely guarded secret though... for now.

[h3]Until Next Time[/h3]

If you've been enjoying DEMONS but haven't left us a Steam review yet then we'd ask you to please consider doing so. Positive reviews are a huge help to us as a new game and we'd really appreciate it.

Look out for another news post with even more details before the update drops. You won't want to miss it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/c88c54bb1d1bf699ea012e494e728e5e3ff996aa.gif[/img]

notes.title: Unleashing the secret DEMONS!
notes.content:
[h1]DEMONS releases to Early Access tomorrow![/h1]

At 6pm GMT tomorrow DEMONS will release to Early Access. So far, we've revealed five of the demons that will be available to challenge in the game, each of them bringing their own unique gameplay twist and requiring smart strategic adjustments to overcome.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/ed590dbc37a0c338cf29545440222ddc8ae848ab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/be0c4004f04b81858fa1624736f20d44b9cde840.png[/img][/url]

These five will be joined on our Early Access launch by three others which have never been officially spoiled... until now! 

[h2]Highwayman[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/19d4e85b810b2323a3e1c54c00d49ae43314aee7.png[/img]

Stand and deliver - your items [b]and[/b] your life! This spectral Highwayman has returned from beyond the grave to threaten every characters equipped items if even one of your team should encounter him during an investigation. Avoiding this demon is one option, but if you find yourself forced to confront him at least try and do it at a time when your team has the least items to lose possible.

[h2]Hellhound[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/684c0ac699da52bd3b3cde93fb062f3aa2d61dfe.png[/img]

This fiery beast from beyond has one weakness. During their investigations players will find [i]Bone[/i] cards which can be used to move the Hellhound from one location to another. However, you'll need the Hellhound card to be face-up to do this, which means finding it at a location with [i]Flashlight[/i] cards first! This demon is an excellent challenge for new players and we strongly recommend it for learning games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/919e7f2bbbd3cc1750f582c38f1fc95f0e555159.png[/img]

[h2]Timereaper[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/2bec839a8f489db0bb3dbeadeedce7aa06dfbd56.png[/img]

Timereaper makes every game a tricky race against the clock, as he moves the [i]Time Lock[/i] card around locations, preventing them from being the first place a character investigates in a turn. Perk cards which allow you to make more than one investigation in a turn are a powerful option against this demon, which also rewards thoughtful planning of what each member of your team is going to do with their action and careful consideration of the order they will act in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/941b4b079371bfdd15a4f376cd68f5a0afd2af12.png[/img]

[h3]See you in the lobbies![/h3]

Which of these new demons are you most looking forward to challenging? Whichever one you're planning to play against you'll want friends to help you get some wins and you'll find many people to play with in the DEMONS Discord, which you can join by clicking the banner below.

[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

If this news post is your first time hearing about the game then don't forget to add us to your wishlist. 

At 6pm GMT tomorrow we unleash the [b]DEMONS[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/6254ab5de6def28c6c126d7a3aa6d9e2edae0134.gif[/img]

notes.title: DEMONS is taking part in Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/0a2d418182b44b231e7c50a3bc97201cce737ae8.jpg[/img]

[h1]DEMONS Is Taking Part In Next Fest![/h1]

Our release to Early Access is fast approaching on March 25th (wishlist us now if you want to get ahead of the game!), but before then you'll have the chance to try out our demo during Steam Next Fest. What can you expect from the demo? Read on to find out...

[h2]Five Demons to Challenge[/h2]

If you've taken part in our playtests over the last year then these terrifying faces will be familiar to you already, but if you're joining us for the first time then meet the demons!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/ed590dbc37a0c338cf29545440222ddc8ae848ab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/be0c4004f04b81858fa1624736f20d44b9cde840.png[/img][/url]

As you can see from the rules text on the cards, each demon presents a unique challenge when you play against it. The different effects they have on the rules of the game mean that it's a good plan to prepare to play against each of them separately by making the most of your Perk card picks. Luckily we've introduced 5 new perks to give you more choice than ever before about what kind of strategy you want to use against these fiendish adversaries...

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/ed590dbc37a0c338cf29545440222ddc8ae848ab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/ed590dbc37a0c338cf29545440222ddc8ae848ab.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Five New Perks[/h2]

Most of our playtests have only featured our original 5 perks, but recently we've added these 5 new ones too. For this demo they will be unlockable using Fate Tokens in the Fate Store. Perks like [i]Last Hope[/i] and [i]Lucky Find[/i] help you get the altars you need to win that may have been lost to the discard pile or be hiding behind demon or cultist cards at a location. [i]Distraction[/i] is a neat way to temporarily take a cultist out and secure a location for investigation. [i]Pay the Devil[/i] and [i]Generous[/i] open up new options for how you make use of the valuable item cards you equip during the game. 

If you're a newcomer to [b]DEMONS[/b] you're now up to speed on what's been happening with the game recently and the basics of what you'll find in our Next Fest demo. Read on to find out about a brand new, never before seen feature, coming to the game for the first time ever with this demo...

[h2]Character Card Effects[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/5da6e8b07439f8ceea9d2619d90e8e87fb256379.gif[/img]

Fresh into the Fate Store for this demo are character card effects. These fun cosmetic skins for your character cards will offer a way to show off your style to team-mates. This 'star performance' effect is just one option - expect to find a few choices waiting for you in the demo. Remember, all our cosmetics are unlockable with in-game currency - we have nothing in the Fate Store that costs real world money! 

[h2]A Mysterious Clue Appears...[/h2]

You've already seen the 5 demons we're featuring for our Next Fest demo, but when we release to Early Access on March 25th another 3 demons will be joining them in the game. I've been digging through the dusty [b]DEMONS[/b] vaults, looking for clues to share with you as to the identity of one of these as yet unseen terrifying tormentors and have found this mysterious card. It appears to be missing it's rules text, but the image alone is quite tantalizing... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/764b53b6f09aac60c768ee9cebc42a8ab0fc121e.png[/img]

What mystical power might this [i]Time Lock[/i] hold? What kind of demon might it accompany? Tell us your guess on what it's game effect will be in the comments, or better still join our friendly group of demon hunters in our Discord community by clicking the link below and share your theories there...

[url=https://discord.gg/KUvkvKyhn4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Play the new DEMONS demo in Steam Scream Fest
notes.content:
[h1]DEMONS is taking part in Steam Scream Fest 2024![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/15fb0425b063ee6cb39439c2733094c0f609c6d6.jpg[/img]

We’re proud to be back taking part in another Steam Scream Fest with our new demo this year. DEMONS will be playable throughout Scream Fest, which begins on October 28th and ends on November 4th.

We’ve prepared some terrifyingly fun new features for this Halloween event - read on to find out more about new unlockable content and a mystery demon who won’t be seen again after this event until we release!

[h2]New Unlockables[/h2]

[h3]Props[/h3]

Every scary movie needs some frightening props and in this demo we’re introducing a bunch of them to the Fate Store! Fate tokens are earned whenever you score a win and can be spent on a variety of cosmetics to customise your game environment in the Fate Store located in the main menu. Until now this has included item skins for your flashlight and wristwatch, but props are a bit different…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/a04ab57e876f760a596d89578904c54edf913cb5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/fe51c2944a8631dfb1cfd54031eff8b7106dfbc4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/972b572c40b2a44823b734ada7b03b391e918a30.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/748ff4a0f00c73e29e64d4abc042ab2c045dc7c9.jpg[/img]

You can equip one of these ghoulish props in the store and it will appear in the game environment next time you play. This means that when you explore the Farmhouse you’ll see your prop and those of your team-mates lurking in it’s grounds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/66f73c62e73ef100e751e81f2a30e67007ce8dee.png[/img]

[h3]Emote Wheel Voice Lines[/h3]

Also new to the Fate Store for this demo are emote wheel voice lines. Once you’ve unlocked these your in-game emotes will be accompanied by a quip from the character you have chosen to play as. These voice lines unlocks will be available in the Fate Store for all 5 characters in this demo - so whoever your favourite is you won’t be left out!

[h2]The Mystery Demon[/h2]

During our playtests and demos we like to provide a few different demons for you to test your skills against. As a special surprise for Scream Fest this demo will include a demon we have never included in an event before and will not include again until release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/3bf4c3d0f34563f1b961422924223f9d303fe2c2.png[/img]

Who is this stranger in the shadows? What fiendish new mechanics will they bring to the game? The only way to find out is to play the demo and see for yourself… if you dare! 

[h2]Until next time…[/h2]

Enjoy the demo & don’t forget to Wishlist the game if you haven’t already. You can also join our community over on Discord by clicking the banner below. It’s an awesome place to talk tactics for the game and find players to team up with to take on the demons. Thanks for playing!

[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

notes.content:
[h1]Sign up for our August Playtest NOW![/h1]

Welcome back [i]DEMONS [/i] fans! Our August playtest is taking place in just a few days time and you can request access over on our Steam page right now. The playtest will open on August 30th and close on September 2nd. What new features can you look forward to helping us test this time? Read on to find out...

[h2]Unlockable Item Skins[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/1ac4c07f2fa316ec5552da34505ef6b15897f727.jpg[/img]

Banishing demons has never been so stylish! This playtest will introduce our game store where you will be able to spend Fate Tokens to unlock alternate skins for items such as the flashlight. Fate Tokens will be earned when you win a game and for this playtest all skins will only cost a single token. This means that every game you win will allow you to unlock an item skin! Please note that this low price is due to the fact that at the conclusion of the playtest we will be resetting unlocks - so any skin you unlock [b]will only be available for this particular playtest[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/39e2a017a49fd1d9aa8249f82b058823401e21b2.jpg[/img]

Flashlights aren't the only item getting a set of skins for this playtest though, as they're joined by the wristwatch. You may have noticed that these unlockables will only be viewable to you - other players can't see your flashlight or wristwatch. For those of you who like to show off - fear not; other unlockables are planned for future playtests which will be visible to all players!

If you don't want to wait that long for a little something to show off your skill to your team mates then you might want to read about the new...

[h2]XP and Rank Titles[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/8d3d3339820340b7a7b29ac89a9871e179c3bf92.jpg[/img]

Whether you win or lose, every game of [i]DEMONS[/i] you play during this playtest will award you XP. The more XP you earn the higher your rank and title will be. You start off as a humble 'survivor' but with a lot of hard work you can climb all the way to the rank of 'chosen one'. These titles will be displayed at the bottom of your character card during games and give you something to show off for your time spent sending demons back to the void! Don't get too attached though as [b]your XP and title will be reset at the conclusion of the playtest[/b]. 

[h2]Featured Demons[/h2]

Those of you who have joined our playtests regularly will know that we feature 3 demons for you to test your skills against. This time is no different with The Leprechaun and The Necromancer joined by fan favourite The Executioner for you to challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/0ba50dea376298364a2789faebaf823bdd49948b.gif[/img]

The Executioner awaits!

[h3]Until Next Time...[/h3]

Stay scary! Thanks for joining us on our development journey. All your bug hunting and playtesting is helping us immensely. Have fun this weekend and see you in the lobbies! Oh and don't forget to join our smashing Discord community by clicking the banner below if you haven't already!

[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: New Demon Reveal - He's the Deadliest Yet!
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Meet the Necromancer[/h1]

We rate our demons difficulty level by a number of skulls displayed in the top left corner of their card. One skull demons are the easiest to play against, whilst demons with two skulls represent a harder challenge. We've never revealed a three skull demon... until now! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/cf87673f42e27b3acff35ca8a57ff901d0416418.gif[/img]

Defeating a cultist in Demons isn't easy. A hatchet card is your only tool to dispatch them safely and often you'll find yourself taking a knockdown when encountering them before they go to the discard pile. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/ab3d30471cbc368b8c9a2f9e4d19c9a96dfac6ee.gif[/img]

The Necromancer poses a huge challenge thanks to it's ability to shuffle cultists back into the draw deck. This means the same cultist card can strike against you multiple times. It also means that the longer you take to win, the more likely you are to run into cultists. Destroying the altars you need to triumph has never been so difficult! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/40ff86799eb196fc56ad01b17e014b1ceeaec0fa.gif[/img]

If that wasn't enough the Necromancer will still hit you with the huge jumpscare and standard attack you'd get with any of our other demons too!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/de1a3443b9480fb47a208b309011ba4fdc5ece8a.gif[/img]


[h2]New Feature: Win Percentage Tracker[/h2]

With a good amount of luck anyone will be able to triumph against our demons once. Truly great [i]DEMONS[/i] players are the ones who can use their skill to win consistently over large numbers of games.

For our upcoming playtest we've added a win percentage tracker to the end game screen which will tell you how many games you've played against a demon and how many of those games you won. Bragging rights go to the players with the highest number of games played + highest number of games won against a demon!

If the loss percentage starts to get too high for your liking there is the option to reset the tracker to zero at any time - but beware - this will also wipe your wins! 

[h3]Are you fearless enough to take on the Necromancer?[/h3] 

Join our Discord by clicking the banner below to get involved with our next free-to-play public playtest, which takes place from June 21st to June 24th.

[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: New Demon Reveal - This One Is No Joke!
notes.content:
[h1]Meet The Jester![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/a18cc3a683538302df73af8903767ef826960ed0.gif[/img]

There's nothing funny about this diabolical court jester! Her card shuffling antics are sure to cause your team some nightmares. Encountering the Jester in game will see all cards at all locations turned face-down and juggled through the air to land at random places. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/0c5482f5b391e562df307ec8bde92d86ba252044.gif[/img] 

Losing track of cards you've worked hard to reveal can be a big enough problem in [i]DEMONS[/i] at the best of times, but the fact that the Jester's ability will also activate when she is revealed by a flashlight search makes this effect even tougher to play around. 

Of course no [i]DEMONS[/i] adversary would be complete without an awesome accompanying jumpscare! Here's a little preview of what to expect...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/c25d0ff883d00b8e7d30eaa2fff1d54024f09b0c.gif[/img]

Are you fearless enough to take on the Jester? Join our Discord by clicking the banner below to get involved with our next playtest, which takes place from June 21st to June 24th.

[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Attention Streamers And Viewers![/h2]

Are you a horror game content creator? Are you a fan of horror game streams? We've got some exciting news for you! [i]DEMONS[/i] will be open to stream during this playtest! Whether you're broadcasting your experience live or making videos for later - it's all good! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/d5bfa91312639dbb9975b71cb9d777391b800cac.gif[/img]

Here's our quick 3 point guide on why we think you might want to give [i]DEMONS[/i] a go with your community: 

1. Games are FAST! A full game of [i]DEMONS[/i] lasts just a few minutes - perfect for lots of viewer participation or filling in down time between other games.

2. [i]DEMONS[/i] is DIFFERENT. We're proud to have created a game that puts a fresh spin on co-op horror. We think fans of the genre are going to be intrigued by this new take on gameplay.

3. [i]DEMONS[/i] is FUN! Whether it's cackling maniacally at seeing your friend run face first into a cultist attack or cheering together as you sequence the perfect series of plays to triumph over the demon at the last second, this game delivers plenty of fun as the unexpected twists and turns of your struggle to destroy the evil summoning altars unfolds differently every play-through.   

[h3]Until Next Time...[/h3]

Stay scary DEMONS fans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/423d6e34246e73bddc0fefd53060991f10c0faf0.gif[/img]

notes.title: Join the DEMONS June Playtest.
notes.content:
[h1]Help Us Banish Bugs from DEMONS![/h1]

From the 21st of June until the 24th of June 2024 DEMONS will be running a free to join open playtest. This is an opportunity to help us hunt bugs and test new features, all whilst having fun defeating some demons at the same time! 

Our Discord community will be where we are collecting feedback on your experiences playing the game. It's also a great place to find teammates for co-op games! Click the banner below to join the friendly folks already there. 

[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

What can you expect in the playtest? Read on to find out more...

[h2]A Brand New Emote System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/eaa66dc824b43d1690df8b7fc09d696b44671b24.gif[/img]

For anyone returning from our previous playtests you'll find a totally new emote system now present in the game environment. Four simple icons open up the possibility of quick communication with your teammates. Warn others of a location you think might be dangerous, encourage strategic plays, or just beg for a first aid kit after being knocked down - how you use them is up to you! 

We're hoping that these emotes will make co-op gameplay easier by eliminating the need for text or voice chat outside of the game for any sort of communication. We'd love to see open lobbies filling up with players willing to give these emotes a whirl as their means of planning a victory together over one of the demons.

Talking of demons...

[h2]Three Demons to Play Against.[/h2]

This playtest will present three different demons to challenge. Each demon brings it's own twist to the rules of the game, so be prepared to shift your strategy depending on which you are facing for the best chance of success. 

We will be revealing the demons that will feature in the playtest in updates right here on Steam over the next couple of weeks. Today we start off with the announcement of a returning demon from our previous playtests - the fearsome Leprechaun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/423d6e34246e73bddc0fefd53060991f10c0faf0.gif[/img]

The other two demons that will be available will be new to all players but participants in our last round of testing will remember the Leprechaun well. Collecting a charm card before encountering him is the only way to avoid being knocked down by his attack so be sure to prioritise perk cards which allow multiple investigations in a turn when facing him. 

[h2]New Soundtrack, Game Environment & Visual Effects.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/7157d9722416b9b3cf823e524d983057a001a320.gif[/img]

This playtest is also a first chance to check out our enhanced game environment - the farmhouse has never looked so scary! It has also never sounded so scary, as a fresh soundtrack heaps on the retro horror vibes while you battle the demons.

[h3]Join Us...[/h3]

We're excited to be creating something with DEMONS that's a fresh twist on the co-op horror genre and the team will be jumping in to games during the playtest to gain feedback first hand. Come play some games with us and until next time - stay scary!

[url=https://discord.gg/qvsGAmwPUp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/20153016c6a4494e7a5988a4a70c89f4d06259f8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Cult of Cards Alpha Playtests
notes.content:
[h1]Are you ready to play Cult of Cards?[/h1]

Every weekend throughout August you can take part in the alpha playtest for Cult of Cards. This early look at the game features: 

- Both solo play and 2-4 player co-op options.

- A short multi-panel tutorial and in game tips to help you learn how to play.

- 3 Demons to battle against.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/b862d19a87ecee3528ecb8f8a35358f338a3d904.jpg[/img]

Although the playtest is only open Friday through Monday over the weekends, you can register for access at any time. Simply head over to the Cult of Cards Steam page and click the 'request access' button. 

[h2]We need your feedback![/h2]

As well as giving you a chance to try out Cult of Cards we hope the playtest will give you an opportunity to tell us what you think of the game. Over on our Discord you can:

- Send us any glitches you find.

- Let us know what you're enjoying and what you think could be better.

- Find other fans to organise multiplayer games with.

Click the banner below to join our Discord community now! 

[url=https://discord.gg/kHC8f52w][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/b77ef70774e2e25bb8bc2835d26a2c0b66aa9d63.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Good luck and have fun.[/h3]

We hope you enjoy the playtest and look forward to hearing from you about your experience. If you like what you see, then remember to add us to your Steam wishlist. We'd really appreciate it!  

Want to keep up with all the latest Cult of Cards news? Drop us a follow over on X/Twitter - https://twitter.com/CultofCards 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589030/e948561f22db90a3bb6e27e13ab8e10ee973dd23.jpg[/img]
